title: Fascinating tour, interesting and engaging.
text: Easy to locate office. Alberto was our lovely tour guide. We walked round to the entrance and given headset ( just for clarity - Albert explained every statue with interest, knowledge and enthusiasm. He was engaging and interactive. Great tour.
author: 931LisaC

title: Go Gaudi
text: An amazing Gaudi experience. Our guide, Oliver, knew Gaudi inside out & shared great info with our group. It was a bummer though that at Casa Batllo he was given a group of Spanish speakers within the larger group of English speakers. Oliver managed this well BUT it was very distracting & disappointing. However when we moved to Casa Milo we were a small English group & Oliver gave us his best. Touring these Gaudi houses is a must do in Barcelona
author: Nick

title: Spectacular visit to Casa Battlo and Casa Miila!
text:
Oliver was a wealth of information about the Casa Battlo. Enjoyed the explanation of the story about St Jordi and the killing if the dragon and how Gaudi transfer all that into the design of the exterior of Casa Battlo.
Once inside, Oliver’s narrative made our minds transport in time and really realized how amazing and what a genious Gaudi was!
Casa Mila’s balconies and roof were spectacular!
Be prepare to climb 5 floors of stairs , but the roof view and structures are sure worth it!!!!
You can also admire Gaudi’s Casa Mila model on the top floor and other interesting models on how Gaudi could
author: Anna_B

title: Beautiful architecture
text: It was the great experience.The guide was amazing.I unfortunately forgot his name , but I was very pleased and my family was as well
author: John_F

title: Amazing! Thank you Sara!
text: Sara was so accomodating with our little 2 year old. Whilst our daughter was a bit tired and cranky, Sara even paused so we can refill her milk bottle and carry on the guided tour. And she took us all around the place. Our little one bonded with her as well. We can’t thank her enough. We enjoyed the tour!
author: Anoop_J

title: Great tour guide for Gaudi and his work!
text: Roberto was an excellent guide.  He was very  knowledgeable, friendly and entertaining.  He gave us the background of the buildings, Gaudi and his workers as well as the people who hired him.  I would gladly go on another tour with him!
author: theatrego

title: Walking Tour along Passeig de Gràcia & Gaudi Houses, Barcelona
text: Great tour.  Our guide was knowledgeable and gave us an excellent history of the buildings and architects as well as the families who commissioned the buildings.  Very interesting and fun.
author: Angela_E

title: 5stars: Highly recommended!

title: Casa Batllo is a living dream.
text:
Our guide, Jonatan, had ample arquitectural knowledge.  The visit to Casa Batalló was Lille walking unto a dream; the interior is just as spectacular as the exterior.
A highly recommended tour for architecture or Gaudi fans.
